newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - May 27.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - May 27.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Tuesday, as reported by Kyodo news agency:
-- Panel urges large amount of cost-cutting in public works spendings.
-- Bad loans of 20 major banks fell by 18 percent in year ended March 31.
-- Conference on fiscal structural reform urges setting of ceiling on social welfare spending.
-- Tokyo District Court orders personal computer network operator Nifty to pay damages in suit over defamatory e-mail messages.
-- Survey shows 40 percent favour and 42 percent oppose organ transplant bill.
-- Three commercial banks -- Nippon Credit Bank Ltd, Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank Ltd and Nippon Trust Bank Ltd -- post pre-tax losses in fiscal year ended March 1997.
